reuse.why: The new action reuses category selection, spreadsheet access, budget writes, and undo infrastructure, but fixed-tag detection reimplements existing shared tag handling.

duplication.why: Most category selection and the six/twelve-month loops are consolidated, but copyPreviousMonth duplicates eligibility policy and the fixed-tag regex duplicates shared tag recognition.

placement.why: Budget orchestration and method registration follow existing layers, although tag recognition belongs in the existing shared tags module.

scope.why: The changes stay focused on the requested month-wide actions, their exclusions, supporting tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared selector and argument type improve ownership, but maintaining a parallel eligibility implementation and separate tag semantics invites future drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth bypasses the introduced getFillableCategories policy, and getCategoriesInFixedGroups bypasses shared/tags.ts tag helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth reshapes getFillableCategories eligibility into early returns over budget rows, while getCategoriesInFixedGroups embeds a bespoke regex for existing shared tag-recognition logic.

abstraction_drift.where: getFillableCategories gains includeHiddenCategories and a conditional hidden-filter branch; copyPreviousMonth continues implementing the same eligibility policy outside that helper.
